as_told.title: Project A119: plan to nuke the moon

plain: In 1958, according to Michels, the US Air Force ran a top secret plan called Project A119 to set off a nuclear bomb on the Moon as a show of force against the Soviet Union, and the astronomer Carl Sagan worked on it as a secret consultant. Michels raises it himself in several episodes, calling it a documented Air Force project, and once he places it at Kirtland Air Force Base, a US Air Force base. Other times he dates it more loosely to the late 1950s and names no base, and he brings it up to show that Sagan, a public voice of scientific caution, had worked inside secret military projects.
